messages.subject: For Stefan Paul | Global logistics, external affairs and country partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Nadelhofer,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Stefan Paul, Chief Executive Officer.

Kuehne+Nagel's global logistics platform operates across complex country, infrastructure and regulatory environments where external affairs and stakeholder relationships directly influence execution. That interface closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and translate external commitments into accountable internal action.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, external affairs and country stakeholder strategy might support Kuehne+Nagel's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Kuehne+Nagel.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
